overview.title: Project Overview
overview.description: Introduction to MOBA's phased business plan and strategy.
overview.detailedDescription: The MOBA project achieves its goals of marine environment protection through a systematic 4-phase approach. Each phase builds upon the achievements of the previous phase, and our ultimate goal is to create a sustainable marine protection ecosystem.

phases.title: Execution Process
phases.subtitle: Education (Certification) → Ploving (Underwater Cleanup) → Data Upload → ESG Reporting

phase1.title: Phase 1: Education & Certification
activities: Dive Against Debris® training (collection, safety, data)
Safety equipment and collection tools provision

phase2.title: Phase 2: Underwater Cleanup (Ploving)
activities: Removal of ghost nets and plastics
Precise GPS, item, weight, count, photo logging

phase3.title: Phase 3: Data Upload & Processing
phase3.description: Upload to international DB and legal waste processing
activities: Upload to Dive Against Debris® platform
Use for UNEP and policy development

phase4.title: Phase 4: ESG Reporting
activities: Environment: volumes, item ratios, carbon reduction
Social: participants, volunteer hours, local cooperation
Governance: safety training, insurance, third-party verification
